meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track and update team goals + KPIs in Hivemind via the `hivemind` CLI. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Hivemind 中创建并追踪团队目标与关键任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们用 Hivemind 管理团队目标和日常任务
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and tasks in Hivemind
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Hivemind to manage goals and tasks

howto.what: Claude 会通过终端运行 `hivemind` 命令来创建、跟踪和更新团队目标与 KPI，也能保存待办任务并恢复上下文。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、KPI、里程碑、任务、待办事项、提醒或任何可衡量的工作项时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个目标：提升用户留存率
保存这个任务：修复登录页的 bug，稍后继续

howto.what_en: Claude will create, track, and update team goals and KPIs via the `hivemind` CLI in the terminal. It can also capture tasks with full context for later resumption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, task, todo, work item, reminder, or any measurable work item.

say_en.text: Create a goal: improve user retention rate
say_en.note: Claude runs `hivemind goal add` and returns the goal_id.

say_en.text: Add a KPI to goal xxx: name active users, target 1000, unit people
Save this task: fix login page bug, resume later
say_en.note: Claude saves with `--agent capture` including full context.
